title: Covalent Bonds and Molecular Shape
summary: Covalent bonds share electrons and their geometry sets a molecule's shape.

key_concepts.explanation: A bond formed by sharing a pair of electrons.
An atom's pull on shared electrons.

outline.heading: Bonding
points: Single, double and triple bonds share one, two or three pairs.
Unequal sharing makes a bond polar.

assignments.task: Draw the Lewis structures on the handout

questions: Why is carbon dioxide nonpolar although its bonds are polar?
